functions.name: frexp
functions.notes: IEEE-754 frexp: normals split into fraction and exponent, subnormals scaled by 2^64 and adjusted by -64, signed zero preserved, infinities/NaN returned unchanged.

validation.comparison: Eighteen values cover zero, signed zero, normals, subnormals, max finite, infinities and NaN. Each compares result bits, the stored exponent word, the complete 67,108,864-byte memory image and the stack pointer.
limitations: Exponent write out of bounds would trap in both implementations but is not exercised.
Ledger: 210 server bodies recovered and 524 remain machine code.
